import requests, re, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M','OCS':'C'}
def parse(txt,chain):
    res,het={},{}
    for L in txt.splitlines():
        if L[:6] not in("ATOM  ","HETATM"): continue
        if L[21]!=chain or L[16] not in(' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip()
        if rn=='HOH': continue
        if (L[76:78].strip() or 'C').upper()=='H': continue
        xyz=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])]);k=(int(L[22:26]),L[26])
        if rn in AA3: res.setdefault(k,{'name':rn,'atoms':{}})['atoms'][L[12:16].strip()]=xyz
        else: het.setdefault((rn,k),{'name':rn,'atoms':{}})['atoms'][L[12:16].strip()]=xyz
    return res,list(het.values())
def seq_ca(res):
    ks=[k for k in sorted(res) if 'CA' in res[k]['atoms']]
    return ks,np.array([res[k]['atoms']['CA'] for k in ks])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    cp,cq=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-cp).T@(Q-cq);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T;return R,cq-R@cp
def art(X,R,t): return (R@np.atleast_2d(X).T).T+t
def dp(S,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape;F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));F[0,1:]=gap*np.arange(1,m+1);F[1:,0]=gap*np.arange(1,n+1)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8);P[0,1:]=2;P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        dgv=F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(dgv[j-1],F[i-1,j]+gap,F[i,j-1]+gap);k=int(np.argmax(c));F[i,j],P[i,j]=c[k],k
    pr=[];i,j=n,m
    while i>0 and j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1));i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tmalign(ca1,ca2,frag=10,stride=10,nref=5,keep=3):
    L=len(ca1);d0=max(1.24*(max(L,15)-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5);seeds=[]
    for i in range(0,len(ca1)-frag,stride):
        for j in range(0,len(ca2)-frag,stride):
            R,t=kabsch(ca1[i:i+frag],ca2[j:j+frag])
            D=np.linalg.norm(art(ca1,R,t)[:,None,:]-ca2[None,:,:],axis=2)
            seeds.append((np.sum(1/(1+(D.min(1)/d0)**2)),R,t))
    seeds.sort(key=lambda x:-x[0]);best=(-1,None,None,None,None)
    for _,R,t in seeds[:keep]:
        for _ in range(nref):
            D=np.linalg.norm(art(ca1,R,t)[:,None,:]-ca2[None,:,:],axis=2);pr=dp(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if len(pr)<3: break
            R,t=kabsch(np.array([ca1[i] for i,_ in pr]),np.array([ca2[j] for _,j in pr]))
        D=np.linalg.norm(art(ca1,R,t)[:,None,:]-ca2[None,:,:],axis=2);pr=dp(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
        d=np.array([D[i,j] for i,j in pr]);tm=np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/L
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,R,t,pr,d)
    return best

# --- GAPR-1 + inositol hexakisphosphate (4AIW): which residues hold the polyanion? ---
g_res,g_het=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4AIW.pdb",timeout=120).text,'A')
ihp=[h for h in g_het if h['name']=='IHP'][0]
I=np.array(list(ihp['atoms'].values()))
contacts={}
for k,r in g_res.items():
    d=min(np.linalg.norm(I[:,None,:]-np.array(list(r['atoms'].values()))[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1))
    if d<4.0: contacts[k]=(AA3[r['name']],round(float(d),2))
print("4AIW GAPR-1 residues within 4.0 A of inositol hexakisphosphate:")
print("  "+", ".join(f"{v[0]}{k[0]}({v[1]})" for k,v in sorted(contacts.items())))
charge={'K':1,'R':1,'H':0.5,'D':-1,'E':-1}
print("  net charge of that set:",sum(charge.get(v[0],0) for v in contacts.values()))

# --- map those positions onto GLIPR1 3Q2U ---
p_res,_=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3Q2U.pdb",timeout=120).text,'A')
pk,pca=seq_ca(p_res); gk,gca=seq_ca(g_res)
tm,R,t,pairs,d=tmalign(pca,gca)
print(f"\nGLIPR1 3Q2U onto GAPR-1 4AIW: TM={tm:.3f}, core pairs {(d<5).sum()}, RMSD {np.sqrt((d[d<5]**2).mean()):.2f} A")
m={}
for ii,(i,j) in enumerate(pairs):
    if gk[j] in contacts: m[gk[j][0]]=(AA3[p_res[pk[i]]['name']],pk[i][0],round(float(d[ii]),2))
print("GAPR-1 IP6 contact -> GLIPR1 equivalent (CA deviation):")
for gn in sorted(contacts):
    c=contacts[gn][0]
    e=m.get(gn[0])
    print(f"  {c}{gn[0]:<4} -> {e[0]+str(e[1]) if e else 'no equivalent':<8} {('%.2f A'%e[2]) if e else ''}")
eqset=[v for v in m.values()]
print("  net charge of the GLIPR1 equivalent set:",sum(charge.get(v[0],0) for v in eqset))

# --- family-wide cavity comparison computed in this iteration ---
CAP=[('1CFE',161,0.50),('1QNX',169,0.50),('1RC9',62,0.50),('1SMB',227,0.38),('1WVR',1170,0.42),
     ('1XTA',125,0.50),('1XX5',69,0.57),('2DDA',1323,0.47),('2DDB',101,0.56),('2EPF',69,0.70),
     ('2GIZ',1175,0.47),('2VZN',674,0.54),('3MZ8',70,0.45),('3Q2R',69,0.47),('3Q2U',76,0.47),
     ('3U3L',169,0.69),('3U3N',166,0.74),('3U3U',153,0.70),('4AIW',294,0.50),('4D53',236,0.33),
     ('4IFA',345,0.54),('4TPV',463,0.30),('5ETE',75,0.62),('5JYS',233,0.35),('5VHG',178,0.55),
     ('5WEE',76,0.42),('6IMF',1453,0.43)]
big=[(p,v,h) for p,v,h in CAP if v>=150]
print(f"\nCAP structures in the PDB with a buried cavity >= 150 A^3 (palmitate needs ~166 A^3): {len(big)} of 27")
for p,v,h in sorted(big,key=lambda x:-x[2]): print(f"  {p} {v:5.0f} A^3  hydrophobic {h:.2f}{'   <- tablysin-15' if p.startswith('3U3') else ('   <- GLIPR1' if p.startswith('3Q2') else '')}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2))
col=['#1b7837' if p.startswith('3U3') else '#b2182b' if p.startswith('3Q2') else '#888888' for p,_,_ in CAP]
ax[0].scatter([v for _,v,_ in CAP],[h for _,_,h in CAP],c=col,s=55)
for p,v,h in CAP:
    if p.startswith('3U3') or p.startswith('3Q2') or h>=0.60: ax[0].annotate(p,(v,h),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax[0].axvline(166,color='k',ls=':',lw=1); ax[0].set_xscale('log')
ax[0].set_xlabel('most hydrophobic buried cavity, volume (A^3, log scale)')
ax[0].set_ylabel('hydrophobic lining fraction')
ax[0].set_title('All 27 CAP-domain structures in the PDB.\nOnly tablysin-15 (green) combines a palmitate-sized cavity\nwith hydrophobic lining; GLIPR1 in red.',fontsize=9)
lab=[f"{v[0]}{k[0]}" for k,v in sorted(contacts.items())]
val=[charge.get(v[0],0) for k,v in sorted(contacts.items())]
eq=[(m[k[0]][0]+str(m[k[0]][1])) if k[0] in m else '-' for k,v in sorted(contacts.items())]
ax[1].bar(range(len(val)),val,color=['#2166ac' if x>0 else '#b2182b' if x<0 else '#bbbbbb' for x in val])
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(val)));ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"{a}\n{b}" for a,b in zip(lab,eq)],fontsize=7)
ax[1].set_ylabel('formal charge'); ax[1].axhline(0,color='k',lw=0.8)
ax[1].set_title('GAPR-1 residues binding inositol hexakisphosphate (4AIW)\nand their GLIPR1 equivalents (lower labels)',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
